prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1250; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with acute neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury observed, and the clinical picture fits the force involved in the event. Over the course of 14 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching guidance, progressing in the expected manner. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, supporting the diagnosis of cervical strain. Other neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At discharge, the patient reported near-complete resolution of symptoms and was released to full activity with a home exercise program.
